description: Ex-Luftwaffe Starfighter displayed indoors in the former Meilenwerk, renamed Motorworld in 2014. It carries the tail of 23+26 and remains privately owned by Robert Dietz (International F-104 Society; 916-starfighter German fate list, 2025). The Traditionsgemeinschaft JaboG 34 at Benningen also references 22+58, so which body holds the airframe should be checked.
